summary: Led the creation of a virtual LXP campus for digital-sector apprentices, combining a web platform, educational content, support services, generative AI and XR.

paragraphs: Temporary text currently under editorial review.

directContributions.label: Backend
directContributions.text: Designed and developed parts of the backend using TypeScript, Node.js, Express and MongoDB.

directContributions.label: Technical architecture
directContributions.text: Migrated the backend to TypeScript, introduced Zod validation, redesigned authentication tokens, implemented API access keys and added server-side pagination.

directContributions.label: Generative AI
directContributions.text: Designed the architecture and protocols for several generative-AI providers.

directContributions.label: Processing and administration
directContributions.text: Developed backend code, a processing queue and administration interfaces.

directContributions.label: Interfaces
directContributions.text: Developed selected interfaces using React and Tailwind CSS.

finalState.title: Project status at completion
finalState.text: The backend and AI ecosystem were operational, four XR applications were completed, and the user interface was approximately 80% complete, with three secondary areas remaining.
